title: Toolchain currency: agentic-flow
requirement: Installed agentic-flow must equal the registry latest.

execution.command_template: test -n "$(bun info 'agentic-flow' version 2>/dev/null)" && test "$(bun info 'agentic-flow' version 2>/dev/null)" = "$(bun pm ls -g 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'agentic\-flow@[0-9][^ ]*' | head -1 | sed 's/.*@//')"

note: Bun's global root is in the XDG_RUNTIME_DIR tmpfs on this host; a missing package after reboot can reflect a prior install that evaporated. This probe made no toolchain changes.
